## Goal

Describe the smallest complete behavior change.

## Compatibility

- [ ] Protocol semantics are unchanged, or a corresponding `RobLe3/IICP` proposal is linked.
- [ ] Public API, fixture and migration effects are documented.
- [ ] No production credentials, topology, data, operator records or task payloads are included.

## Verification

- [ ] `composer validate`
- [ ] `composer audit --locked`
- [ ] `php artisan test --compact`
- [ ] Seed-parity check

List any additional evidence and rollback considerations.
